title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
layout_note: Two identical vision columns (photo, encoder trapezoid, resampler box) stand side by side on the left; the right half stacks, from the bottom up, the interleaved input band, the processed-text strip, a tinted LM container and the output box. The input sits at the bottom right, and a line running under the whole figure carries its images back to the left-hand columns.
grouping: Two colour families encode training status, defined in a bordered legend box in the top-left corner: medium blue with a snowflake = pretrained and frozen, lilac = trained from scratch. The language model is a pale blue borderless background panel holding alternating pairs (n-th LM block in blue above n-th GATED XATTN-DENSE in lilac), with a dotted vertical line between the n-th and the 1st pair standing for the repeated layers. Each vision branch is a vertical column (photo, blue trapezoid encoder, lilac Perceiver Resampler). The right-hand strips are labelled by bold monospace headings (Output: text, Processed text, Interleaved visual/text data); the input is a light grey full-width band with two photos set inline with text.
shapes_depth: Flat, borderless, square-cornered filled rectangles with no shadows; the vision encoders are trapezoids that widen downward. The output box is pale pink with a thin pink outline and the processed-text strip is a white box with a thin black outline. Connections are thin black orthogonal elbow lines with small arrowheads; each resampler sends one line into the n-th and one into the 1st gated cross-attention layer, entering the container from the left. Images appear as square photo thumbnails, text as plain monospace strings (no token glyphs). A snowflake icon marks every frozen block and a small circular logo icon sits beside the output box.
proposed_highlight: The paper's trained modules (Perceiver Resampler and GATED XATTN-DENSE) share one lilac fill, named in the legend as trained from scratch, while all reused pretrained parts are blue and carry a snowflake. The new layers are drawn interleaved between the frozen LM blocks, so the alternation itself shows where they are inserted; the gated layer's name is set in upper case.
lesson: A two-entry legend (snowflake on blue = pretrained and frozen, plain lilac = trained from scratch) lets fill colour alone say which boxes the paper trains, and interleaving lilac layers between blue LM blocks shows where they are inserted.
notes: One monospace typeface throughout, bold for section headings. A concrete example travels through the figure: the interleaved sentence with two photos, its processed form with <image> markers, and a generated sentence in the output box, so the overview doubles as a worked example. Venue as recorded from the arXiv journal-ref; year = arXiv preprint year (2204.14198).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

insights.structure: Two identical vision columns (photo, frozen trapezoid encoder, Perceiver Resampler) stand on the left; the right half stacks interleaved input, processed text, a pale-blue LM container of alternating LM block / GATED XATTN-DENSE pairs, and the output box.
insights.data: Inputs are real dog and cat photos and a grey band of quoted interleaved text with inline thumbnails; the processed text shows literal '<image>' tokens and the output is the quoted sentence 'a very serious cat.' in a pink box.
insights.emphasis: A two-entry legend in the top-left corner maps blue+snowflake to frozen and lilac to trained-from-scratch, so the new gated layers read as lilac stripes interleaved between frozen blue LM blocks.
insights.flow: Everything reads bottom-to-top; a line under the whole figure carries the images from the interleaved band back left to the vision columns, and resampler outputs run right in elbow lines into every gated layer.
insights.avoid: The resampler-to-xattn lines cross and nest four deep on the left of the LM container, making it hard to see which column feeds which layer.

arrangement.units: one composition: vision branch columns left (unframed), a pale-blue borderless panel holding the LM layers right
arrangement.inputs_as: real photos at the bottom of each vision column and a grey band of interleaved image-text data at bottom right
arrangement.losses_at: none drawn; output text box at top
arrangement.shared: vision encoder/resampler columns repeated per image
